description: This file defines an API health check class for monitoring the health status of a web API endpoint related to catalog items in an e-commerce web application. It uses HttpClient to perform an HTTP GET request to verify that the catalog-items endpoint is returning expected content.

classes.name: ApiHealthCheck
classes.description: Implements IHealthCheck to perform a health check on the catalog-items API endpoint by fetching content and verifying the presence of a specific product string.

methods.name: ApiHealthCheck
methods.description: Constructor that accepts configuration options to set the base URL for API calls.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the catalog-items endpoint and checks if the response contains a specific product indicator to determine health status.
